why: This course will help to provide learners with knowledge and understanding of business improvement techniques, which can be applied across many different sectors and job roles.

will: Understand safe and effective team working

whatyoulearn: Describe the specific regulations, safe working practices and procedures that apply to a work activity
Explain what constitutes a hazard in the workplace
Explain what constitutes a risk in the workplace
Identify potential risks and hazards associated with a work activity
Describe how potential risks and hazards can be reduced
